fixes.title: Remove static sitemap.xml and robots.txt so each domain gets its own
fixes.why: Apache serves real files before Laravel routes, so both domains were serving the old main-site sitemap (www URLs, 45 pages). The foundation's own pages were not submitted to Google.

fixes.title: 301 www and http to https without www, on both domains
fixes.why: Today every page loads four ways (http/https, with/without www), and the www copy even sets its own canonical. Google splits signals between the copies. The deploy's live check follows redirects, so a redirect loop would fail it and roll back.

fixes.title: Block public access to build files (composer.lock, Dockerfile, README.md and similar)
fixes.why: These files reveal package versions and server setup. They are never needed by visitors.

fixes.title: Add llms.txt for both domains
fixes.why: Gives AI assistants a clean summary of each site and its key pages. Rebuilt from live pages daily.

fixes.title: Page titles, descriptions and canonicals (34 changes)
fixes.why:
Titles and descriptions live in the admin panel database, which the bot never touches. These overrides sit in one JSON file and win over the database text for the listed paths only. Foundation copies of clinic pages point their canonical to the clinic site. Remove a path from the file to undo it. Setup: adds `seo_head()` to app/helpers.php; frontMaster passes the page head through `seo_head()`.
